name: chromium-devtools-mcp

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List tabs of the session or tabs available to claim.

scope.description: Owned tabs or tabs available to claim. Defaults to owned.

limit.description: Maximum tabs to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List open sessions of the daemon without their tab details.

tools.name: select_tab
tools.description: Select a tab of the session, claiming an available tab when needed.

tab.description: Tab id returned by the tab tools.

tools.name: new_tab
tools.description: Open a new background tab and select it. With a url it waits until the page has loaded or timeoutMs passes, and returns the committed url, the load state reached and the document readyState.

url.description: URL to open: http, https or about:blank. Defaults to about:blank.

select.description: Select the new tab. Defaults to true.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the page to load. Defaults to 30000 ms.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab opened by this session.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

tools.name: page_info
tools.description: Read the URL, title, viewport and scroll position of a tab.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

tools.name: page_navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab to a URL, back, forward or reload it, waiting for the page to load.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to url.

url.description: URL to open, http, https or about:blank. Required for the url action.

waitUntil.description: Wait for the load event, DOMContentLoaded, or return at once. Defaults to load.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the page. Defaults to 30000 ms.

ignoreCache.description: Reload ignoring the cache. Only for the reload action.

tools.name: js_evaluate
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a tab and return the result. Page exceptions come back as data, not as tool errors.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

awaitPromise.description: Await a promise result. Defaults to true.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the result. Defaults to 10000 ms.

maxResultChars.description: Maximum characters of the returned value. Defaults to 50000.

target.description: Run the expression against an element. A function expression is called as is, anything else runs as the body of function (element) { ... }. Both receive the element as this and as the first argument.

tools.name: dom_query
tools.description: Find elements by a CSS selector and read their text, attributes and boxes. Total counts every match in the page; the text filter scans at most the first 2000 matches and pierce visits at most 20000 elements; truncated reports when more matches exist than returned or a cap applied.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

selector.description: CSS selector to match. Use >>> to chain through shadow roots, for example my-app >>> #inner.

all.description: Return up to limit matches instead of one. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 20 with all and to 1 without it.

text.description: Keep only elements whose text contains this, case insensitively.

includeBox.description: Include bounding boxes. Defaults to true.

pierce.description: Match through open shadow roots. Closed shadow roots need a >>> chain. Defaults to false.

frame.description: Frame id from dom_snapshot or an iframe CSS selector that matches exactly one iframe. Defaults to the main frame.

tools.name: dom_snapshot
tools.description: Read a compact text snapshot of the page with element ids for later calls. Take a new snapshot after the page changes. It reads at most 20000 accessibility nodes, at most 50 levels deep, and the DOM to 10 levels; truncated reports when a cap applied.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of the snapshot text. Defaults to 50000.

interactiveOnly.description: List only interactive elements. Defaults to false.

root.description: Limit the snapshot to the subtree of this element.

includeHidden.description: Include hidden elements. Defaults to false.

maxFrames.description: Maximum iframe contents to include. Defaults to 20. Frames beyond the limit are listed with omitted true.

tools.name: css_inspect
tools.description: Read the computed style, matched CSS rules and box of an element. The box is null for an element without a rendered box, such as display none.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector.

properties.description: Computed style properties to return. Defaults to a curated layout and typography list.

includeMatchedRules.description: Include the matched CSS rules. Defaults to true.

maxRules.description: Maximum matched rules to return. Defaults to 30.

includeBox.description: Include the box model. Defaults to true.

tools.name: console_logs
tools.description: Read console messages, uncaught exceptions and browser messages of a tab. Only messages since capture started, plus what the browser replays.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

textContains.description: Keep only messages containing this text.

afterId.description: Return entries after this id for paging.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 100.

clear.description: Empty the buffer after reading. Defaults to false.

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: Read HTTP requests of a tab since network capture started. Sensitive query values and header values are replaced by [redacted].

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

urlContains.description: Keep only URLs containing this text.

urlRegex.description: Keep only URLs matching this regular expression, up to 200 characters. A match that takes longer than 50 ms is stopped and fails the call.

resourceTypes.description: Keep only these CDP resource types.

statusMin.description: Keep only responses with at least this status.

statusMax.description: Keep only responses with at most this status.

afterId.description: Return records after this id for paging.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Defaults to 50.

includeHeaders.description: Include redacted request and response headers. Defaults to false.

clear.description: Empty the buffer after reading. Defaults to false.

tools.name: network_response_body
tools.description: Read the response body of a request from network_requests. Binary bodies need asBase64.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of the returned body. Defaults to 50000.

asBase64.description: Return binary content as base64. Defaults to false.

tools.name: network_mock
tools.description: Mock network responses or fail requests of a tab by URL pattern. The first matching rule in insertion order wins.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

rule.description: Rule to add, for the add action.

response.description: Mocked response, exactly one of response and fail.

status.description: HTTP status of the mocked response, 200 to 599.

body.description: Response body as text, mutually exclusive with bodyBase64.

bodyBase64.description: Response body as base64, mutually exclusive with body.

contentType.description: Content type, added when no content-type header is given.

fail.description: Network failure, exactly one of response and fail.

delayMs.description: Delay before resolving, 0 to 30000. Defaults to 0.

times.description: Apply this many times, then expire.

id.description: Rule id, for the remove action.

tools.name: page_dialogs
tools.description: See and resolve JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload) of a tab, or set an automatic policy.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to status.

promptText.description: Text for a prompt, up to 10000 characters.

policy.description: Automatic handling for dialogs that open later. Defaults to none and is cleared on reset.

tools.name: page_wait
tools.description: Wait for a selector, text, URL, load state or expression in a tab. A timeout is a result with met false, not an error. The expression condition runs arbitrary page JavaScript.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

text.description: Substring of the visible page text to wait for.

urlRegex.description: URL regular expression to wait for, up to 200 characters. A match that takes longer than 50 ms is stopped and fails the call.

loadState.description: Page load state to wait for.

expression.description: JavaScript expression that must become truthy.

ms.description: Plain sleep in ms, up to 60000.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait. Defaults to 10000 ms.

pollMs.description: Poll interval in ms. Defaults to 100.

pierce.description: Match the selector through open shadow roots. Only with a selector condition. Defaults to false.

frame.description: Frame id from dom_snapshot to wait in. Only with a selector condition. Defaults to the main frame.

tools.name: storage_read
tools.description: Read local storage, session storage or cookies of the page origin. Cookie values are secrets and stay hidden unless includeValues is true.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

keys.description: Storage keys to read, for local and session. Defaults to all.

maxEntries.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 100.

maxValueChars.description: Maximum characters per value. Defaults to 500.

includeValues.description: Include values. Defaults to true for storage, false for cookies.

tools.name: storage_write
tools.description: Write local storage, session storage or cookies of the page origin. Values are never echoed back.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

entries.description: Entries to set, for local and session. At most 100.

keys.description: Keys to remove, for local and session.

domain.description: Cookie domain. Defaults to the page host.

expires.description: Expiry as seconds since the epoch.

httpOnly.description: Whether the cookie is hidden from page scripts.

domain.description: Cookie domain. Defaults to the page host.

tools.name: page_pdf
tools.description: Print a tab to PDF. Needs a headless managed browser when the headed browser refuses to print.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

landscape.description: Use landscape orientation. Defaults to false.

printBackground.description: Print background graphics. Defaults to true.

paperWidth.description: Paper width in inches. Defaults to A4.

paperHeight.description: Paper height in inches. Defaults to A4.

margins.description: Margins in inches. Defaults to 0.4 on every side.

preferCSSPageSize.description: Prefer the CSS page size. Defaults to false.

maxBytes.description: Maximum PDF bytes. Defaults to 8 MiB.

tools.name: page_metrics
tools.description: Read performance counters, layout metrics and navigation timing of a tab.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a tab as an image. Defaults to jpeg quality 80 to keep outputs small; works on background tabs without focusing them.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

quality.description: Quality for jpeg and webp. Defaults to 80.

fullPage.description: Capture beyond the viewport. Defaults to false.

target.description: Clip to this element after scrolling it into view.

clip.description: Clip to this CSS rectangle in page coordinates measured from the document origin. Rejected together with target.

maxBytes.description: Maximum image bytes. Defaults to 4 MiB.

maxDimension.description: Clamp the longest side to this many pixels. Defaults to 4096.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the built in devices for emulate_device, with an optional name or kind filter.

query.description: Case insensitive substring filter on the name.

kind.description: Keep only phones, tablets or desktops.

tools.name: emulate_device
tools.description: Emulate a device size, pixel ratio, mobile viewport, touch and user agent on a tab. Reads back what the page reports. The Chrome version in a device user agent follows the connected browser. Client hints metadata is not emulated.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

device.description: Device name from list_devices, case insensitive.

width.description: Explicit CSS width, 100 to 10000. Needs height, deviceScaleFactor, mobile and touch.

userAgent.description: User agent for explicit emulation. Defaults to the real one.

landscape.description: Swap width and height. Defaults to false.

reset.description: Remove the device overrides of this tab. Defaults to false.

tools.name: emulate_media
tools.description: Emulate a media type and media features on a tab. Only the given fields change; reset removes every media override.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

media.description: Media type to emulate, empty clears the type.

reset.description: Remove the media overrides of this tab. Defaults to false.

tools.name: emulate_network
tools.description: Emulate network conditions on a tab: offline, slow-3g (2000 ms, 400/400 Kbps), fast-3g (562 ms, 1600/750 Kbps), 4g (170 ms, 9000/9000 Kbps), wifi (28 ms, 30000/15000 Kbps) or none. Shares Network.enable with the capture manager, never disables capture.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

preset.description: Named conditions. none restores a normal connection and clears blocked URLs.

downloadKbps.description: Download ceiling in Kbps, at least 1, -1 disables throttling. 0 is rejected because it stalls the link.

uploadKbps.description: Upload ceiling in Kbps, at least 1, -1 disables throttling. 0 is rejected because it stalls the link.

blockUrls.description: URL patterns to block with CDP wildcards, at most 50.

reset.description: Restore a normal connection and clear blocked URLs. Defaults to false.

tools.name: emulate_locale
tools.description: Emulate locale, timezone and Accept-Language on a tab. Applies to new page loads: navigator.language changes after the next navigation, and number and date formatting follow the locale. Geolocation is not emulated. reset restores the real locale and timezone.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag such as de-DE. Merges with the previous timezone and accept language.

acceptLanguage.description: Accept-Language header value, printable ASCII. Merges with the device user agent.

reset.description: Remove the locale overrides of this tab. Defaults to false.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element at the DOM level with element.click() semantics, without moving the mouse.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector.

scrollIntoView.description: Scroll the element into view first. Defaults to true.

tools.name: input_click
tools.description: Click at an element with trusted CDP mouse events, like a real user, without focusing the window.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector.

clickCount.description: How many clicks in a row, 1 to 3. Defaults to 1.

modifiers.description: Held modifiers, for example Control for a control click.

position.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the top left corner of the element. Defaults to the center.

x.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the left edge of the element.

y.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the top edge of the element.

force.description: Skip the hit test and click through a covering element. Defaults to false.

tools.name: input_hover
tools.description: Hover an element with trusted CDP mouse events, so hover styles and menus react.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector.

position.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the top left corner of the element. Defaults to the center.

x.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the left edge of the element.

y.description: Offset in CSS pixels from the top edge of the element.

force.description: Skip the hit test and hover through a covering element. Defaults to false.

tools.name: input_type
tools.description: Type text into a field with trusted input events, focusing it first without clicking.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

text.description: Text to type, up to 20000 characters.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector. Omit to type into the focused element.

clear.description: Select all and delete in the field first. Defaults to false.

submit.description: Press Enter after typing. Defaults to false.

delayMs.description: Delay between characters in ms, 0 to 200. With 0 the text is inserted at once. delayMs times the text length must not exceed 60000 ms. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: input_key
tools.description: Press a key or chord like Enter or ControlOrMeta+C with trusted CDP key events.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

key.description: Key or chord, for example Enter, Tab, Control+A, ControlOrMeta+C, Shift++ (a trailing plus names the plus key).

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector. The element is focused first; omit to press into the focused element.

repeat.description: How many times to press, 1 to 20. Modifiers are held across repeats. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: input_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page by wheel deltas, to an edge, or an element into view, with trusted wheel events.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector. Scrolls it into view; combine with block.

block.description: Vertical alignment inside the viewport when scrolling to an element. Defaults to center.

deltaX.description: Horizontal pixels to scroll, negative scrolls left.

deltaY.description: Vertical pixels to scroll, negative scrolls up.

at.description: Point where the wheel turns. Defaults to the viewport center.

x.description: Viewport X in CSS pixels where the wheel turns.

y.description: Viewport Y in CSS pixels where the wheel turns.

to.description: Scroll to the top or the bottom of the page.

tools.name: input_select
tools.description: Choose options of a select element by value, label or index, firing input and change.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector. Must resolve to a select.

values.description: Option values to select, exactly one of values, labels or indexes.

labels.description: Visible option labels to select, exactly one of values, labels or indexes.

indexes.description: Option indexes to select, exactly one of values, labels or indexes.

tools.name: input_upload
tools.description: Attach local files to a file input. The most sensitive input tool: it sends local files to a web page.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the selected tab.

target.description: Element uid from a snapshot or query, or a CSS selector. Must resolve to an input of type file.

files.description: Absolute local paths to attach, at most 20. Each must be a readable file under 100 MiB.

instructions: Drive a Chromium browser. Tabs open in the background with new_tab; most tools act on the selected tab or on a tab id from list_tabs. Element targets use a uid from a snapshot or a CSS selector, never both. Large outputs are truncated with an explicit marker.
